died.name: Andronikos I Komnenos
died.last_words: Lord, have mercy upon me. Wilt thou break a bruised reed?

died.name: Jean-Philippe Rameau
died.last_words: What the devil do you mean to sing to me, priest? You are out of tune.

died.name: Edward Thurlow, 1st Baron Thurlow
died.last_words: I'll be shot if I don't believe I'm dying.

died.name: Gebhard Leberecht von Blücher
died.cause: to his aide-de-camp, August Ludwig von Nostitz
died.last_words: Nostitz, you have learned many a thing from me. Now you are to learn how peacefully a man can die.

died.name: Park Benjamin Sr.
died.cause: when his wife asked him if he knew her
died.last_words: Why should I not know you, Mary?

died.name: William Pitt
died.cause: a Canadian ferryman who designed the underwater cable ferry as means of improving the former ferry used to connect the Kingston Peninsula to the Kennebecasis Valley in New Brunswick. In 1909, Pitt died after sustaining injuries caused by falling into his ferry's machinery.

died.name: Winston Ide
died.cause: responding to requests to save himself during the sinking of the Rakuyo Maru
died.last_words: I'm staying here. In any case, I can swim to Australia if I have to.

died.name: Ricardo López
died.cause: before committing suicide with a gun after he mailed a bomb to Icelandic musician Björk, attempting to kill her

born.name: François-Jean de la Barre
born.cause: prior to execution by beheading for blasphemy and sacrilege
born.last_words: I did not think that they would put a young gentleman to death for such a trifle.
